summary.text: Brooks Landgraf is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 81 who has served since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Ceasar Sanchez is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Brooks Landgraf earned a B.S. from Texas A&M University in 2003 and a J.D. from St. Mary's University in 2008, according to Ballotpedia.
He assumed office in the Texas House in 2015.
For 2023-2024 he chaired the Environmental Regulation Committee and was also assigned to the House Administration, House Transportation and Redistricting committees.
